columns.name: title
columns.description: Auto-generated description e.g. "High latency on payment-service"

columns.name: root_cause
columns.description: AI-analyzed root cause, nullable until analyzed

columns.name: triggering_alerts
columns.description: Array of alert IDs that created this incident

columns.name: confidence_score
columns.description: Day 2: root_cause_analyzer's overall confidence in the root cause (0.0-1.0)

columns.name: matched_runbook_id
columns.description: Day 2: id of the best-matching runbook, or null

columns.name: correlation_group_id
columns.description: Day 2: the alerts.correlation_group this incident was created from (used to prevent duplicate incidents per group)
